title: Storage Units, Covered Parking and Guest Suite Nights by Apartment Type (Independent Living)
content:
Each Independent Living Residency Agreement includes a set of amenity allowances that depends on the apartment type; anything beyond the allowance is rented at the rates below (US dollars).

## Storage and parking

| Apartment type | One storage unit included in the monthly service fee | Monthly rent of a storage unit not included | Covered parking spaces included (garage spaces for cottage homes) | Monthly rent per covered space beyond those included |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | No | 45.00 | 0 | 55.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | No | 45.00 | 0 | 55.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | Yes | 45.00 | 1 | 55.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | Yes | 45.00 | 1 | 55.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | Yes | 45.00 | 1 | 55.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | Yes | 45.00 | 1 | 55.00 |

## Guest suite

| Apartment type | Guest suite nights included at no charge per calendar year | Rate for each further night | Longest single booking |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 0 | 119.00 | 7 consecutive nights |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 0 | 119.00 | 7 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 2 | 119.00 | 7 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 2 | 119.00 | 7 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 4 | 119.00 | 7 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 4 | 119.00 | 7 |

## Notes

- "Included" storage means one unit is covered by the monthly service fee; the monthly storage rent of 45.00 applies to a unit that is not included.
- Covered parking is rented at 55.00 per space per month for each space beyond the included number.
- Guest suite nights included at no charge are counted per calendar year; every further night is charged at 119.00.

Hypothetical example: a Studio household renting one storage unit and one covered space has 45.00 plus 55.00, a total of 100.00, of amenity rent in a month.
